title: chamaecrista viscosa var. paraguayensis
intro: Chamaecrista viscosa var. paraguayensis, commonly known as Paraguay sensitive plant, is a plant species that belongs to the Fabaceae family. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce pain and inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of Paraguay sensitive plant include flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
